def globalMixedProfileConstant (j l : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  4 * (4 : ℝ) ^ j * mixedTimeConstant j l + normalizedProfileConstant j l

theorem globalMixedProfileConstant_nonneg (j l : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ globalMixedProfileConstant j l := by

theorem intervalImageCandidate_sub_one_mixed_iteratedDeriv (j l : ℕ) (a z T y : ℝ)
    (hjl : j + l ≤ 3) (ha : 0 < a) (hz : |z| ≤ a) (hT : 0 < T) (hy : |y| < a) :
    iteratedDeriv l (fun S => iteratedDeriv j (fun w => intervalImageCandidate a z S w - 1) y) T =
      mixedImageCandidate j l a z T y - (if j = 0 ∧ l = 0 then 1 else 0) := by

theorem mixedImageCandidate_highTime_profile (j l : ℕ) (a z T y : ℝ)
    (hjl : j + l ≤ 3) (ha : 0 < a) (hz : |z| ≤ a) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hlarge : a ^ 2 ≤ T) (hy : |y| < a) :
    |mixedImageCandidate j l a z T y - (if j = 0 ∧ l = 0 then 1 else 0)| ≤
      normalizedProfileConstant j l * (1 / Real.sqrt T) ^ (j + 2 * l) *
        (1 + |z - y| / Real.sqrt T) ^ j * intervalProfile a y T z := by

theorem mixedImageCandidate_global_profile (j l : ℕ) (a z T y : ℝ)
    (hjl : j + l ≤ 3) (ha : 0 < a) (hz : |z| ≤ a) (hT : 0 < T) (hy : |y| < a) :
    |mixedImageCandidate j l a z T y - (if j = 0 ∧ l = 0 then 1 else 0)| ≤
      globalMixedProfileConstant j l * (1 / Real.sqrt T) ^ (j + 2 * l) *
        (1 + |z - y| / Real.sqrt T) ^ j * intervalProfile a y T z := by

theorem mixedImageCandidate_segment_global_profile (j l : ℕ) (a y z T b θ : ℝ)
    (hjl : j + l ≤ 3) (ha : 0 < a) (hy : |y| < a) (hz : |z| ≤ a)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hsmall : b ^ 2 ≤ T / 2) (hnew : |y + b| ≤ a)
    (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) :
    |mixedImageCandidate j l a z (T - θ * b ^ 2) (y + θ * b) -
        (if j = 0 ∧ l = 0 then 1 else 0)| ≤
      (globalMixedProfileConstant j l * (2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 2 * l) * (3 : ℝ) ^ j) *
        (1 / Real.sqrt T) ^ (j + 2 * l) * (1 + |z - y| / Real.sqrt T) ^ j *
          intervalIncrementProfile a y T z b := by

end Shao.C2.IntervalImageGlobalProfiles

import Shao.C2.IntervalImageLagrangeRemainder

noncomputable section
namespace Shao.C2.IntervalImageGlobalProfiles
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped BigOperators Topology
open Shao.C2.IntervalImageCandidateSpatial Shao.C2.IntervalImageMixedCandidate
open Shao.C2.IntervalImageMixedTerms Shao.C2.IntervalImageSmallTimeSum
open Shao.C2.IntervalImageTaylorSegment Shao.C2.HalfLineTaylorSegment
open Shao.C2.IntervalImageSineProfiles Shao.C2.IntervalSineHighTimeProfiles
open Shao.C2.CompletionFirstProfile

def globalMixedProfileConstant (j l : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  4 * (4 : ℝ) ^ j * mixedTimeConstant j l + normalizedProfileConstant j l

theorem globalMixedProfileConstant_nonneg (j l : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ globalMixedProfileConstant j l := by
  have hM := mixedTimeConstant_nonneg j l
  have hN := normalizedProfileConstant_nonneg j l
  dsimp only [globalMixedProfileConstant]
  positivity

theorem intervalImageCandidate_sub_one_mixed_iteratedDeriv (j l : ℕ) (a z T y : ℝ)
    (hjl : j + l ≤ 3) (ha : 0 < a) (hz : |z| ≤ a) (hT : 0 < T) (hy : |y| < a) :
    iteratedDeriv l (fun S => iteratedDeriv j (fun w => intervalImageCandidate a z S w - 1) y) T =
      mixedImageCandidate j l a z T y - (if j = 0 ∧ l = 0 then 1 else 0) := by
  have hshift (n : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) :
      iteratedDeriv n (fun w => f w - 1) x = iteratedDeriv n f x := by
    have heq : (fun w => f w - 1) = (fun w => (-1 : ℝ) + f w) := by funext w; ring
    rw [heq]
    exact iteratedDeriv_const_add hn (-1 : ℝ)
  by_cases hzero : j + l = 0
  · have hj : j = 0 := by omega
    have hl : l = 0 := by omega
    subst j
    subst l
    have hh := intervalImageCandidate_mixed_iteratedDeriv 0 0 a z T y (by norm_num) ha hz hT hy
    simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero] at hh
    simpa using congrArg (fun q : ℝ => q - 1) hh
  · have hnot : ¬(j = 0 ∧ l = 0) := by omega
    rw [if_neg hnot, sub_zero]
    by_cases hj : j = 0
    · subst j
      have hl : 0 < l := by omega
      change iteratedDeriv l (fun S => intervalImageCandidate a z S y - 1) T = _
      rw [hshift l (fun S => intervalImageCandidate a z S y) T hl]
      simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using
        intervalImageCandidate_mixed_iteratedDeriv 0 l a z T y (by omega) ha hz hT hy
    · have hj' : 0 < j := by omega
      have heq : (fun S => iteratedDeriv j (fun w => intervalImageCandidate a z S w - 1) y) =
          (fun S => iteratedDeriv j (intervalImageCandidate a z S) y) := by
        funext S
        exact hshift j (intervalImageCandidate a z S) y hj'
      rw [heq]
      exact intervalImageCandidate_mixed_iteratedDeriv j l a z T y (by omega) ha hz hT hy

theorem mixedImageCandidate_highTime_profile (j l : ℕ) (a z T y : ℝ)
    (hjl : j + l ≤ 3) (ha : 0 < a) (hz : |z| ≤ a) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hlarge : a ^ 2 ≤ T) (hy : |y| < a) :
    |mixedImageCandidate j l a z T y - (if j = 0 ∧ l = 0 then 1 else 0)| ≤
      normalizedProfileConstant j l * (1 / Real.sqrt T) ^ (j + 2 * l) *
        (1 + |z - y| / Real.sqrt T) ^ j * intervalProfile a y T z := by
  have h := intervalImageCandidate_sub_one_highTime_profile j l a z T y hjl ha hz hT hlarge hy
  rw [intervalImageCandidate_sub_one_mixed_iteratedDeriv j l a z T y hjl ha hz hT hy] at h
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using h

theorem mixedImageCandidate_global_profile (j l : ℕ) (a z T y : ℝ)
    (hjl : j + l ≤ 3) (ha : 0 < a) (hz : |z| ≤ a) (hT : 0 < T) (hy : |y| < a) :
    |mixedImageCandidate j l a z T y - (if j = 0 ∧ l = 0 then 1 else 0)| ≤
      globalMixedProfileConstant j l * (1 / Real.sqrt T) ^ (j + 2 * l) *
        (1 + |z - y| / Real.sqrt T) ^ j * intervalProfile a y T z := by
  let R : ℝ := (1 / Real.sqrt T) ^ (j + 2 * l) *
    (1 + |z - y| / Real.sqrt T) ^ j * intervalProfile a y T z
  have hP : 0 ≤ intervalProfile a y T z := by
    dsimp only [intervalProfile, upperProfile, lowerProfile]
    positivity
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := by dsimp only [R]; positivity
  by_cases hSmall : T ≤ a ^ 2
  · have hb := mixedImageCandidate_smallTime_profile j l a z T y (by omega) ha hz hT hy.le hSmall
    have hs := mixed_scale_inv_sqrt j l (z - y) T hT
    have heq : 4 * (4 / Real.sqrt T * (1 + |z - y| / Real.sqrt T)) ^ j *
        mixedTimeConstant j l / T ^ l * intervalProfile a y T z =
        (4 * (4 : ℝ) ^ j * mixedTimeConstant j l) * R := by
      calc
        _ = (4 * mixedTimeConstant j l) *
            ((4 / Real.sqrt T * (1 + |z - y| / Real.sqrt T)) ^ j / T ^ l) *
              intervalProfile a y T z := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hs]; dsimp only [R]; ring
    have hC : 4 * (4 : ℝ) ^ j * mixedTimeConstant j l ≤ globalMixedProfileConstant j l := by
      dsimp only [globalMixedProfileConstant]
      linarith only [normalizedProfileConstant_nonneg j l]
    calc
      _ ≤ (4 * (4 : ℝ) ^ j * mixedTimeConstant j l) * R := heq ▸ hb
      _ ≤ globalMixedProfileConstant j l * R := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC hR
      _ = _ := by dsimp only [R]; ring
  · have hb := mixedImageCandidate_highTime_profile j l a z T y hjl ha hz hT (le_of_not_ge hSmall) hy
    have hM : 0 ≤ 4 * (4 : ℝ) ^ j * mixedTimeConstant j l :=
      mul_nonneg (by positivity) (mixedTimeConstant_nonneg j l)
    have hC : normalizedProfileConstant j l ≤ globalMixedProfileConstant j l := by
      dsimp only [globalMixedProfileConstant]
      linarith only [hM]
    calc
      _ ≤ normalizedProfileConstant j l * R := by simpa only [R, mul_assoc] using hb
      _ ≤ globalMixedProfileConstant j l * R := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC hR
      _ = _ := by dsimp only [R]; ring

theorem mixedImageCandidate_segment_global_profile (j l : ℕ) (a y z T b θ : ℝ)
    (hjl : j + l ≤ 3) (ha : 0 < a) (hy : |y| < a) (hz : |z| ≤ a)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hsmall : b ^ 2 ≤ T / 2) (hnew : |y + b| ≤ a)
    (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) :
    |mixedImageCandidate j l a z (T - θ * b ^ 2) (y + θ * b) -
        (if j = 0 ∧ l = 0 then 1 else 0)| ≤
      (globalMixedProfileConstant j l * (2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 2 * l) * (3 : ℝ) ^ j) *
        (1 / Real.sqrt T) ^ (j + 2 * l) * (1 + |z - y| / Real.sqrt T) ^ j *
          intervalIncrementProfile a y T z b := by
  have hS := (segment_energy_bounds T b θ hT hsmall hθ0 hθ1.le).1
  have hyS := segment_space_interior a y b θ hy hnew hθ0 hθ1
  have hb := mixedImageCandidate_global_profile j l a z (T - θ * b ^ 2) (y + θ * b)
    hjl ha hz hS hyS
  have ht := interval_segment_profile_transport a y z T b θ (j + 2 * l) j
    hy hz hT hsmall hnew hθ0 hθ1.le
  have hC := globalMixedProfileConstant_nonneg j l
  calc
    _ ≤ globalMixedProfileConstant j l *
        ((1 / Real.sqrt (segmentEnergy T b θ)) ^ (j + 2 * l) *
          (1 + |z - (y + θ * b)| / Real.sqrt (segmentEnergy T b θ)) ^ j *
            intervalProfile a (y + θ * b) (segmentEnergy T b θ) z) := by
      simpa only [segmentEnergy, mul_assoc] using hb
    _ ≤ globalMixedProfileConstant j l *
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 2 * l) * (3 : ℝ) ^ j * (1 / Real.sqrt T) ^ (j + 2 * l) *
          (1 + |z - y| / Real.sqrt T) ^ j * intervalIncrementProfile a y T z b) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht hC
    _ = _ := by ring

end Shao.C2.IntervalImageGlobalProfiles

noncomputable section
namespace Shao.C2.IntervalImageRevealBounds
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped BigOperators Topology
open Shao.C2.IntervalImageCandidateSpatial Shao.C2.IntervalImageMixedCandidate
open Shao.C2.IntervalImageRevealDerivatives Shao.C2.IntervalImageLagrangeRemainder
open Shao.C2.IntervalImageGlobalProfiles Shao.C2.IntervalGaussianLocal
open Shao.C2.HalfLineSmallTaylor Shao.C2.HalfLineTaylorSegment

def segmentMixedProfileConstant (j l : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  globalMixedProfileConstant j l * (2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 2 * l) * (3 : ℝ) ^ j

def thirdPathProfileConstant : ℝ :=
  segmentMixedProfileConstant 3 0 + 3 * segmentMixedProfileConstant 2 1 +
    3 * segmentMixedProfileConstant 1 2 + segmentMixedProfileConstant 0 3

def compensatedProfileConstant : ℝ :=
  thirdPathProfileConstant / 6 + segmentMixedProfileConstant 1 1 +
    segmentMixedProfileConstant 0 2 / 2

theorem segmentMixedProfileConstant_nonneg (j l : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ segmentMixedProfileConstant j l := by
  dsimp only [segmentMixedProfileConstant]
  exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (globalMixedProfileConstant_nonneg j l) (by positivity)) (by positivity)

theorem thirdPathProfileConstant_nonneg : 0 ≤ thirdPathProfileConstant := by
  have h30 := segmentMixedProfileConstant_nonneg 3 0
  have h21 := segmentMixedProfileConstant_nonneg 2 1
  have h12 := segmentMixedProfileConstant_nonneg 1 2
  have h03 := segmentMixedProfileConstant_nonneg 0 3
  dsimp only [thirdPathProfileConstant]
  positivity

theorem compensatedProfileConstant_nonneg : 0 ≤ compensatedProfileConstant := by
  have h3 := thirdPathProfileConstant_nonneg
  have h11 := segmentMixedProfileConstant_nonneg 1 1
  have h02 := segmentMixedProfileConstant_nonneg 0 2
  dsimp only [compensatedProfileConstant]
  positivity

theorem weighted_segment_mixed_bound (j l : ℕ) (a y z T b θ : ℝ)
    (hjl : j + l ≤ 3) (horder : 3 ≤ j + 2 * l)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hy : |y| < a) (hz : |z| ≤ a)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hsmall : b ^ 2 ≤ T / 2) (hnew : |y + b| ≤ a)
    (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) :
    |b| ^ (j + 2 * l) * |mixedImageCandidate j l a z (T - θ * b ^ 2) (y + θ * b)| ≤
      segmentMixedProfileConstant j l * (|b| / Real.sqrt T) ^ 3 *
        (1 + |z - y| / Real.sqrt T) ^ 3 * intervalIncrementProfile a y T z b := by
  let q : ℝ := |b| / Real.sqrt T
  let D : ℝ := 1 + |z - y| / Real.sqrt T
  let P : ℝ := intervalIncrementProfile a y T z b
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt T := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hT
  have hs2 : (Real.sqrt T) ^ 2 = T := Real.sq_sqrt hT.le
  have hbs : |b| ≤ Real.sqrt T := by
    nlinarith [sq_abs b, abs_nonneg b, Real.sqrt_nonneg T]
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := by dsimp only [q]; positivity
  have hq1 : q ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hs).2 hbs
  have hD : 1 ≤ D := by
    dsimp only [D]
    linarith only [div_nonneg (abs_nonneg (z - y)) hs.le]
  have hP : 0 ≤ P := by
    dsimp only [P, intervalIncrementProfile, incrementProfile]
    positivity
  have hnot : ¬(j = 0 ∧ l = 0) := by omega
  have hb : |mixedImageCandidate j l a z (T - θ * b ^ 2) (y + θ * b)| ≤
      segmentMixedProfileConstant j l * (1 / Real.sqrt T) ^ (j + 2 * l) * D ^ j * P := by
    simpa only [if_neg hnot, sub_zero, segmentMixedProfileConstant, D, P] using
      mixedImageCandidate_segment_global_profile j l a y z T b θ hjl ha hy hz hT hsmall hnew hθ0 hθ1
  have hd := normalized_power_domination q D hq0 hq1 hD (j + 2 * l - 3) j (by omega)
  have hr : 3 + (j + 2 * l - 3) = j + 2 * l := by omega
  rw [hr] at hd
  have hqeq : |b| ^ (j + 2 * l) * (1 / Real.sqrt T) ^ (j + 2 * l) = q ^ (j + 2 * l) := by
    dsimp only [q]
    rw [div_pow, one_div_pow]
    ring
  have hC := segmentMixedProfileConstant_nonneg j l
  calc
    _ ≤ |b| ^ (j + 2 * l) *
        (segmentMixedProfileConstant j l * (1 / Real.sqrt T) ^ (j + 2 * l) * D ^ j * P) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg b) _)
    _ = segmentMixedProfileConstant j l * (q ^ (j + 2 * l) * D ^ j) * P := by
      rw [← hqeq]
      ring
    _ ≤ segmentMixedProfileConstant j l * (q ^ 3 * D ^ 3) * P :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd hC) hP
    _ = _ := by dsimp only [q, D, P]; ring

theorem pathThird_segment_profile (a y z T b θ : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hy : |y| < a) (hz : |z| ≤ a)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hsmall : b ^ 2 ≤ T / 2) (hnew : |y + b| ≤ a)
    (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) :
    |pathThird a z T y b θ| ≤
      thirdPathProfileConstant * (|b| / Real.sqrt T) ^ 3 *
        (1 + |z - y| / Real.sqrt T) ^ 3 * intervalIncrementProfile a y T z b := by
  let R : ℝ := (|b| / Real.sqrt T) ^ 3 *
    (1 + |z - y| / Real.sqrt T) ^ 3 * intervalIncrementProfile a y T z b
  let A := b ^ 3 * mixedImageCandidate 3 0 a z (T - θ * b ^ 2) (y + θ * b)
  let B := 3 * b ^ 4 * mixedImageCandidate 2 1 a z (T - θ * b ^ 2) (y + θ * b)
  let C := 3 * b ^ 5 * mixedImageCandidate 1 2 a z (T - θ * b ^ 2) (y + θ * b)
  let F := b ^ 6 * mixedImageCandidate 0 3 a z (T - θ * b ^ 2) (y + θ * b)
  have h30 : |b| ^ 3 * |mixedImageCandidate 3 0 a z (T - θ * b ^ 2) (y + θ * b)| ≤
      segmentMixedProfileConstant 3 0 * R := by
    simpa only [R, mul_assoc] using
      weighted_segment_mixed_bound 3 0 a y z T b θ (by norm_num) (by norm_num) ha hy hz hT hsmall hnew hθ0 hθ1
  have h21 : |b| ^ 4 * |mixedImageCandidate 2 1 a z (T - θ * b ^ 2) (y + θ * b)| ≤
      segmentMixedProfileConstant 2 1 * R := by
    simpa only [R, mul_assoc] using
      weighted_segment_mixed_bound 2 1 a y z T b θ (by norm_num) (by norm_num) ha hy hz hT hsmall hnew hθ0 hθ1
  have h12 : |b| ^ 5 * |mixedImageCandidate 1 2 a z (T - θ * b ^ 2) (y + θ * b)| ≤
      segmentMixedProfileConstant 1 2 * R := by
    simpa only [R, mul_assoc] using
      weighted_segment_mixed_bound 1 2 a y z T b θ (by norm_num) (by norm_num) ha hy hz hT hsmall hnew hθ0 hθ1
  have h03 : |b| ^ 6 * |mixedImageCandidate 0 3 a z (T - θ * b ^ 2) (y + θ * b)| ≤
      segmentMixedProfileConstant 0 3 * R := by
    simpa only [R, mul_assoc] using
      weighted_segment_mixed_bound 0 3 a y z T b θ (by norm_num) (by norm_num) ha hy hz hT hsmall hnew hθ0 hθ1
  have hA : |A| ≤ segmentMixedProfileConstant 3 0 * R := by
    simpa only [A, abs_mul, abs_pow] using h30
  have hB : |B| ≤ 3 * segmentMixedProfileConstant 2 1 * R := by
    calc
      _ = 3 * (|b| ^ 4 * |mixedImageCandidate 2 1 a z (T - θ * b ^ 2) (y + θ * b)|) := by
        dsimp only [B]
        simp only [abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3)]
        ring
      _ ≤ 3 * (segmentMixedProfileConstant 2 1 * R) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h21 (by norm_num)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hC : |C| ≤ 3 * segmentMixedProfileConstant 1 2 * R := by
    calc
      _ = 3 * (|b| ^ 5 * |mixedImageCandidate 1 2 a z (T - θ * b ^ 2) (y + θ * b)|) := by
        dsimp only [C]
        simp only [abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3)]
        ring
      _ ≤ 3 * (segmentMixedProfileConstant 1 2 * R) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h12 (by norm_num)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hF : |F| ≤ segmentMixedProfileConstant 0 3 * R := by
    simpa only [F, abs_mul, abs_pow] using h03
  have hab : |A - B| ≤ |A| + |B| := by
    simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, abs_neg] using abs_add_le A (-B)
  have habc := abs_add_le (A - B) C
  have habcf : |A - B + C - F| ≤ |A - B + C| + |F| := by
    simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, abs_neg] using abs_add_le (A - B + C) (-F)
  have htri : |A - B + C - F| ≤ |A| + |B| + |C| + |F| := by
    linarith only [hab, habc, habcf]
  change |A - B + C - F| ≤ thirdPathProfileConstant * R
  dsimp only [thirdPathProfileConstant]
  linarith only [htri, hA, hB, hC, hF]

theorem intervalImageCandidate_compensated_small_step_bound (a y z T b : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hy : |y| < a) (hz : |z| ≤ a)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hsmall : b ^ 2 ≤ T / 2) (hnew : |y + b| < a) :
    |intervalImageCandidate a z (T - b ^ 2) (y + b) - intervalImageCandidate a z T y -
        (b - b ^ 2 * (z - y) / T) * deriv (intervalImageCandidate a z T) y| ≤
      compensatedProfileConstant * (|b| / Real.sqrt T) ^ 3 *
        (1 + |z - y| / Real.sqrt T) ^ 3 * intervalIncrementProfile a y T z b := by
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ, heq⟩ := compensated_lagrange_remainder a z T y b ha hz hT hy hsmall hnew
  let R : ℝ := (|b| / Real.sqrt T) ^ 3 *
    (1 + |z - y| / Real.sqrt T) ^ 3 * intervalIncrementProfile a y T z b
  let A := (1 / 6 : ℝ) * pathThird a z T y b θ
  let B := b ^ 3 * mixedImageCandidate 1 1 a z T y
  let C := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (b ^ 4 * mixedImageCandidate 0 2 a z T y)
  have h3 : |pathThird a z T y b θ| ≤ thirdPathProfileConstant * R := by
    simpa only [R, mul_assoc] using
      pathThird_segment_profile a y z T b θ ha hy hz hT hsmall hnew.le hθ.1.le hθ.2
  have hA : |A| ≤ thirdPathProfileConstant / 6 * R := by
    calc
      _ = (1 / 6 : ℝ) * |pathThird a z T y b θ| := by dsimp only [A]; rw [abs_mul]; norm_num
      _ ≤ (1 / 6 : ℝ) * (thirdPathProfileConstant * R) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (by norm_num)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hB : |B| ≤ segmentMixedProfileConstant 1 1 * R := by
    simpa only [B, abs_mul, abs_pow, zero_mul, sub_zero, add_zero, R, mul_assoc] using
      weighted_segment_mixed_bound 1 1 a y z T b 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) ha hy hz hT hsmall hnew.le (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have h02 : |b ^ 4 * mixedImageCandidate 0 2 a z T y| ≤ segmentMixedProfileConstant 0 2 * R := by
    simpa only [abs_mul, abs_pow, zero_mul, sub_zero, add_zero, R, mul_assoc] using
      weighted_segment_mixed_bound 0 2 a y z T b 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) ha hy hz hT hsmall hnew.le (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hC : |C| ≤ segmentMixedProfileConstant 0 2 / 2 * R := by
    calc
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * |b ^ 4 * mixedImageCandidate 0 2 a z T y| := by dsimp only [C]; rw [abs_mul]; norm_num
      _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (segmentMixedProfileConstant 0 2 * R) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h02 (by norm_num)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hab : |A - B| ≤ |A| + |B| := by
    simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, abs_neg] using abs_add_le A (-B)
  have habc := abs_add_le (A - B) C
  have hfinal : |A - B + C| ≤ compensatedProfileConstant * R := by
    dsimp only [compensatedProfileConstant]
    linarith only [hab, habc, hA, hB, hC]
  rw [heq]
  convert hfinal using 1 <;> dsimp only [A, B, C, R] <;> ring

end Shao.C2.IntervalImageRevealBounds

import Shao.C2.IntervalImageRevealBounds

noncomputable section
namespace Shao.C2.IntervalImageWallLimit
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped BigOperators Topology
open Shao.C2.IntervalImageCandidateSpatial Shao.C2.IntervalImageMixedCandidate
open Shao.C2.IntervalImageJointContinuity Shao.C2.IntervalImageTaylorSegment
open Shao.C2.IntervalImageRevealBounds Shao.C2.IntervalGaussianLocal

theorem intervalImageCandidate_joint_continuousOn (a z H U : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hz : |z| ≤ a) (hH : 0 < H) (hHU : H ≤ U) :
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => intervalImageCandidate a z p.2 p.1)
      (Icc (-a) a ×ˢ Icc H U) := by
  have heq : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => intervalImageCandidate a z p.2 p.1) =
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => mixedImageCandidate 0 0 a z p.2 p.1) := by
    funext p
    exact (mixedImageCandidate_zero 0 a z p.2 p.1).symm
  rw [heq]
  exact mixedImageCandidate_joint_continuousOn 0 0 a z H U (by norm_num) ha hz hH hHU

theorem intervalImageCandidate_scaled_step_continuousOn (a y z T b : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hy : |y| < a) (hz : |z| ≤ a)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hsmall : b ^ 2 ≤ T / 2) (hnew : |y + b| ≤ a) :
    ContinuousOn (fun θ : ℝ => intervalImageCandidate a z (T - (θ * b) ^ 2) (y + θ * b))
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
  have hc := intervalImageCandidate_joint_continuousOn a z (T / 2) T ha hz
    (by linarith only [hT]) (by linarith only [hT])
  have hp : ContinuousOn (fun θ : ℝ => (y + θ * b, T - (θ * b) ^ 2)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    fun_prop
  apply hc.comp hp
  intro θ hθ
  have hyθ := segment_space_closed a y b θ hy hnew hθ.1 hθ.2
  have hθsq : θ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith only [hθ.1, hθ.2]
  have hbθ : (θ * b) ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2 := by
    calc
      _ = θ ^ 2 * b ^ 2 := mul_pow θ b 2
      _ ≤ 1 * b ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hθsq (sq_nonneg b)
      _ = _ := one_mul _
  exact ⟨abs_le.mp hyθ, by nlinarith only [hbθ, hsmall], by nlinarith only [sq_nonneg (θ * b)]⟩

theorem intervalImageCandidate_compensated_small_step_closed_bound (a y z T b : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hy : |y| < a) (hz : |z| ≤ a)

namespace Shao.C2.BridgeIntervalImageConsumer
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal Topology
open Shao.C2.BridgeDomination Shao.C2.BrownianBridgeLaw
open Shao.C2.SourceIntervalCompletion Shao.C2.ActualIntervalProjection
open Shao.C2.IntervalImageCandidateSpatial Shao.C2.IntervalImageWallValues
open Shao.C2.IntervalImageRevealBounds Shao.C2.IntervalImageWallLimit
open Shao.C2.IntervalGaussianLocal Shao.C2.IntervalGaussianLargeStep

theorem sourceIntervalCompletion_eq_image_of_interior (ν : Measure BridgeNoise)
    (a z S w : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hz : |z| ≤ a) (hS : 0 < S) (hw : |w| ≤ a)
    (hImage : ∀ U : ℝ, 0 < U → ∀ v : ℝ, |v| < a →
      intervalCompletion ν a v U z = intervalImageCandidate a z U v) :
    sourceIntervalCompletion ν a w S z = intervalImageCandidate a z S w := by
  by_cases hw' : |w| < a
  · rw [sourceIntervalCompletion_pos ν a w S z hS]
    exact hImage S hS w hw'
  · have hzero : sourceIntervalCompletion ν a w S z = 0 :=
      sourceIntervalCompletion_exterior ν a w S z (fun h => hw' h.1)
    rw [hzero]
    have heq : |w| = a := le_antisymm hw (le_of_not_gt hw')
    rcases le_total 0 w with hw0 | hw0
    · have hwA : w = a := by simpa only [abs_of_nonneg hw0] using heq
      rw [hwA]
      exact (intervalImageCandidate_upper_wall a z S ha hz hS).symm
    · have hneg : -w = a := by simpa only [abs_of_nonpos hw0] using heq
      have hwA : w = -a := by linarith only [hneg]
      rw [hwA]
      exact (intervalImageCandidate_lower_wall a z S ha hz hS).symm

theorem sourceIntervalCompletion_spatial_hasDerivAt_of_image (ν : Measure BridgeNoise)
    (a y T z : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hy : |y| < a) (hz : |z| ≤ a) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hImage : ∀ U : ℝ, 0 < U → ∀ v : ℝ, |v| < a →
      intervalCompletion ν a v U z = intervalImageCandidate a z U v) :
    HasDerivAt (fun w => sourceIntervalCompletion ν a w T z)
      (deriv (intervalImageCandidate a z T) y) y := by
  have hDiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (intervalImageCandidate a z T) y :=
    (imageCandidateSpatial_hasDerivAt 0 a z T y ha hz hT hy).differentiableAt
  have heq : (fun w => sourceIntervalCompletion ν a w T z) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
      intervalImageCandidate a z T := by
    filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds (abs_lt.mp hy)] with w hw
    rw [sourceIntervalCompletion_pos ν a w T z hT]
    exact hImage T hT w (abs_lt.mpr hw)
  exact hDiff.hasDerivAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq

theorem sourceRemainder_eq_image_of_interior (ν : Measure BridgeNoise)
    (a y T z b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hy : |y| < a) (hz : |z| ≤ a) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hsmall : b ^ 2 ≤ T / 2) (hnew : |y + b| ≤ a)
    (hImage : ∀ U : ℝ, 0 < U → ∀ v : ℝ, |v| < a →
      intervalCompletion ν a v U z = intervalImageCandidate a z U v) :
    sourceRemainder ν a y T z b =
      intervalImageCandidate a z (T - b ^ 2) (y + b) - intervalImageCandidate a z T y -
        (b - b ^ 2 * (z - y) / T) * deriv (intervalImageCandidate a z T) y := by
  have hS : 0 < T - b ^ 2 := by linarith only [hT, hsmall]
  unfold sourceRemainder
  rw [sourceIntervalCompletion_eq_image_of_interior ν a z (T - b ^ 2) (y + b) ha hz hS hnew hImage,
    sourceIntervalCompletion_eq_image_of_interior ν a z T y ha hz hT hy.le hImage,
    (sourceIntervalCompletion_spatial_hasDerivAt_of_image ν a y T z ha hy hz hT hImage).deriv]

theorem sourceRemainder_small_bound_of_image (ν : Measure BridgeNoise)
    (a y T z b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hy : |y| < a) (hz : |z| ≤ a) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hsmall : b ^ 2 ≤ T / 2) (hnew : |y + b| ≤ a)
    (hImage : ∀ U : ℝ, 0 < U → ∀ v : ℝ, |v| < a →
      intervalCompletion ν a v U z = intervalImageCandidate a z U v) :
    |sourceRemainder ν a y T z b| ≤
      compensatedProfileConstant * (|b| / Real.sqrt T) ^ 3 *
        (1 + |z - y| / Real.sqrt T) ^ 3 * intervalIncrementProfile a y T z b := by
  rw [sourceRemainder_eq_image_of_interior ν a y T z b ha hy hz hT hsmall hnew hImage]
  exact intervalImageCandidate_compensated_small_step_closed_bound a y z T b ha hy hz hT hsmall hnew

theorem actual_interval_retained_bound_of_image
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hB : IsBrownianReal B P)
    (a y T z b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hy : |y| < a) (hz : |z| < a) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hb : b ^ 2 ≤ T) (hzero : T - b ^ 2 = 0 → y + b = z)
    (hImage : ∀ U : ℝ, 0 < U → ∀ v : ℝ, |v| < a →
      intervalCompletion (bridgeLaw B P) a v U z = intervalImageCandidate a z U v) :
    |retainedRemainder (bridgeLaw B P) a y T z b| + negativeOvershoot (bridgeLaw B P) a y T z b ≤
      (2 * compensatedProfileConstant + 40) * (|b| / Real.sqrt T) ^ 3 *
        (1 + |z - y| / Real.sqrt T) ^ 3 * intervalEnvelope a y T z b := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (bridgeLaw B P) := isProbabilityMeasure_bridgeLaw B P hB
  have hRegular := (sourceIntervalCompletion_spatial_hasDerivAt_of_image
    (bridgeLaw B P) a y T z ha hy hz.le hT hImage).differentiableAt
  apply actual_interval_local_gaussian_bound (bridgeLaw B P) a y T z b compensatedProfileConstant
    ha hy hz hT hb compensatedProfileConstant_nonneg hzero hRegular
  · intro S hS w hw
    exact Shao.C2.BridgeUpperAffineIdentification.bridge_upper_formula B P hB a w S z hS hw (abs_lt.mp hz).2
  · intro S hS w hw
    exact Shao.C2.BridgeLowerIdentification.bridge_lower_formula B P hB a w S z hS hw (abs_lt.mp hz).1
  · intro β hβ hnew
    have hbound := sourceRemainder_small_bound_of_image (bridgeLaw B P) a y T z β
      ha hy hz.le hT hβ hnew hImage
    convert hbound using 1 <;> ring

end Shao.C2.BridgeIntervalImageConsumer

originalSource.fullRelevantText:
\subsection{A common completion kernel and its local remainders}

For a fixed $a>0$ let $I$ be either $(-a,a)$, $(-\infty,a)$, or
$(-a,\infty)$. For interior endpoints $y,z$ and $T>0$, define
\begin{equation}\label{cn:kerneldef}
 f^I_a(y,T;z)=\frac{k_T^I(y,z)}{\phi_T(z-y)},\qquad
 \phi_T(d)=(2\pi T)^{-1/2}e^{-d^2/(2T)}.
\end{equation}
This is the strict Brownian-bridge survival probability. We suppress $a,I$
when fixed. Its extension is zero if either endpoint is on or outside
the monitored walls. At a reachable zero-energy future its two endpoints
coincide; its value is one if that endpoint is interior. For terminal
envelopes only, a zero-variance bridge with different endpoints means
their deterministic linear interpolation. For $a=0$ all completions
are assigned zero.

Let $\mathcal S$ be the set of monitored wall signs: $\{+1,-1\}$ for
the interval, $\{+1\}$ for the upper half-line, and $\{-1\}$ for the
lower half-line. Write
\[
 d=z-y,\quad D=1+|d|/\sqrt T,\quad
 u_\eta=a-\eta y,\quad v_\eta=a-\eta z,
\]
\begin{equation}\label{cn:profiles}
 P(y,T;z)=\sum_{\eta\in\mathcal S}e^{-u_\eta v_\eta/T},
 \qquad
 P_b(y,T;z)=\sum_{\eta\in\mathcal S}
 e^{-(u_\eta-|b|)_+v_\eta/T}.
\end{equation}
In particular every such profile is at most two. Differentiation always
holds the walls and terminal endpoint fixed.

\begin{lemma}[Derivative and Taylor bounds]\label{cn:kernel}
For fixed nonnegative integers $j,l$, in particular for $j+l\le3$,
\begin{equation}\label{cn:derivative}
 |\partial_y^j\partial_T^l(f-1)|
 \le C_{j,l}T^{-j/2-l}D^jP(y,T;z).
\end{equation}
The same one-sided estimates hold at a wall. The quotient satisfies
\begin{equation}\label{cn:PDE}
 f_T=\tfrac12f_{yy}+(d/T)f_y.
\end{equation}
For $b^2\le T$, define the compensated remainder at an actual reveal by
\begin{equation}\label{cn:remainder}
 \mathfrak r_b=f_{\mathrm{ext}}(y+b,T-b^2;z)-f(y,T;z)
                 -(b-b^2d/T)f_y(y,T;z).
\end{equation}
If $b^2\le T/2$ and the new spatial point is in the closed domain,
\begin{equation}\label{cn:smallTaylor}
 |\mathfrak r_b|
 \le C|b|^3T^{-3/2}D^3P_b(y,T;z).
\end{equation}
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
For a half-line, $f=1-e^{-2u_\eta v_\eta/T}$ by reflection. For
$\eta=+1$, put $C=2(a-y)(a-z)$; the reflected case is identical.
The exponent is affine in $y$, and
$|C_y|\le2|d|+\sqrt{2C}$. Repeated differentiation gives a polynomial
in $C/T$, times $C_y^jT^{-j-l}e^{-C/T}$. Absorbing the polynomial
and the powers of $\sqrt{C/T}$ into half the exponential proves
\eqref{cn:derivative}, with no lower bound on either endpoint.

For the interval, the image expansion divided by the free density is
\begin{align*}
 f&=\sum_{m\in\mathbb Z}(e^{-A_m/T}-e^{-B_m/T}),\\
 A_m&=8m^2a^2+4ma d,\qquad
 B_m=2(y+(2m+1)a)(z+(2m+1)a).
\end{align*}
Here $A_0=0$ supplies the constant one; every other exponent is
nonnegative and affine in $y$. Each such exponent $C$ satisfies
$|C_y|\le2|d|+\sqrt{2C}$: for $A_m$ use
$A_m=(A_{m,y}-d)^2/2-d^2/2$, and for $B_m$ use that its two factors
have the same sign and differ by $d$. Thus a differentiated image term
is bounded by
\[
 C_{j,l}T^{-j/2-l}D^j e^{-C/(2T)}.
\]
When $T\le a^2$, set $B_0=2u_-v_-$ and $B_{-1}=2u_+v_+$.
For $m\ge1$,
\[
 B_m\ge B_0+8m^2a^2,\qquad
 A_m\ge B_0+8m(m-1)a^2.
\]
The second inequality follows from
$A_1-B_0=2(a-y)(3a+z)\ge0$ and $d\ge-2a$.
The negative side similarly has
$A_{-m}\ge B_{-1}+8m(m-1)a^2$, using
$A_{-1}-B_{-1}=2(a+y)(3a-z)\ge0$, and the analogous square tail
for the remaining $B$ terms. Their Gaussian series is bounded by a
constant times $P$. This proves \eqref{cn:derivative} in this range.

If $T\ge a^2$, the sine expansion of the killed heat kernel yields
\[
 |\partial_y^j\partial_T^l k_T^I|
 \le C_{j,l}T^{-(j+2l+1)/2}.
\]
For example, after taking absolute values its series is bounded by
$Ca^{-j-2l-1}\sum_{m\ge1}m^{j+2l}e^{-c m^2T/a^2}$;
the exponential dominates the required power for $T/a^2\ge1$.
Since $|d|/\sqrt T\le2$, derivatives of the reciprocal free density
have the corresponding bounds
$CT^{(1-j-2l)/2}$. Leibniz's rule bounds every positive-order
derivative of $f$ by $CT^{-j/2-l}$. For order zero use
$|f-1|\le1$. Finally $u_\eta v_\eta\le4a^2\le4T$, so
$P\ge2e^{-4}$. This proves the desired profile estimate also here.
The normally convergent positive-time expansions justify all
differentiations and one-sided traces. Dividing the heat equation for
$k$ by the free heat equation gives \eqref{cn:PDE}.

For \eqref{cn:smallTaylor}, apply second-order Taylor expansion along
$(y+sb,T-sb^2)$, $0\le s\le1$. Its variance time is in $[T/2,T]$,
its drift factor is at most $CD$, and its profile is at most $P_b$.
The leading terms are
\[
 b f_y-b^2 f_T+\tfrac12b^2f_{yy}
 =(b-b^2d/T)f_y.
\]
The other second-order terms are $-b^3f_{yT}+b^4f_{TT}/2$.
Each third-order directional term has normalized power
$(|b|/\sqrt T)^{j+2l}D^j$ with $j+l=3$. Since
$|b|/\sqrt T\le1$ and $j+2l\ge3$, all these terms are at most
$C|b|^3T^{-3/2}D^3P_b$. A point on the wall uses the smooth
one-sided zero trace.

\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}[A projection pays its own negative overshoot]\label{cn:projection}
Suppose $y,z\in I$ and $y+b$ hits or crosses a monitored wall with
sign $\eta=\operatorname{sign}(b)$, where $b^2\le T/2$. Put
\[
 B=|b|,\quad u=a-\eta y\in(0,B],\quad p=\eta u,\quad
 \delta=B-u,\quad c=1-\eta(B+u)d/T.
\]
Then, for the interval and either half-line,
\begin{align}
 \mathfrak r_b&=\mathfrak r_p+O_b,
 &O_b&=-\eta\delta c f_y,\qquad0\le c\le2D,
                                                        \label{cn:projectionid}\\
 |\mathfrak r_p|+(O_b)_-
 &\le CuB^2T^{-3/2}D^3
 \le CB^3T^{-3/2}D^3.                                  \label{cn:projectbound}
\end{align}
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
Both the crossing and its projection have zero completion, so
subtraction in \eqref{cn:remainder} proves the identity. Since
$\eta d<u$, one has
$c\ge1-2b^2/T\ge0$ and
$c\le1+2(B/\sqrt T)(D-1)\le2D$.
The projected segment has time at least $T/2$; thus
\eqref{cn:smallTaylor}, with $|p|=u$ and $P_p\le2$, gives
$|\mathfrak r_p|\le Cu^3T^{-3/2}D^3$.

Set $A=1-\eta ud/T\ge1-u^2/T\ge1/2$. Nonnegativity of $f$ and the exact identity
$\mathfrak r_p=-f-\eta uAf_y$ imply
$uA(\eta f_y)_+\le|\mathfrak r_p|$.
The identity $((B+u)/u)A-c=B/u$ gives $c/A\le(B+u)/u$, so
\[

 \le\left(1+\frac{\delta(B+u)}{u^2}\right)|\mathfrak r_p|
 \le C\{u^3+\delta u(B+u)\}T^{-3/2}D^3
 =CuB^2T^{-3/2}D^3.
\]
The projected displacement need not be a remaining label. Equality
hits have $\delta=0$; the projected endpoint uses the one-sided wall trace.
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}[One local Gaussian wall envelope]\label{cn:localprofile}
At any actual reveal state with $a,T>0$, $y,z\in I$ and $b^2\le T$,
let $\ell_b^I$ retain $\mathfrak r_b$ except at a small-energy crossing,
where it retains $\mathfrak r_p$. For each monitored wall put
\[
 w_\eta=a-\eta y,\quad M_\eta=|b|+(\eta d)_+,\quad
 \Pi=\sum_{\eta\in\mathcal S}e^{-((w_\eta-M_\eta)_+)^2/T},
 \qquad q=|b|/\sqrt T.
\]
Then, with the second term present only for an interval,
\begin{equation}\label{cn:localprofilebound}
 |\ell_b^I|+1_{\{\text{small-energy crossing}\}}(O_b)_-
 \le Cq^3D^3\Pi.
\end{equation}
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
For a small interior step use \eqref{cn:smallTaylor} and the wallwise
inequality
$(w_\eta-|b|)_+(w_\eta-\eta d)
\ge((w_\eta-M_\eta)_+)^2$, which gives $P_b\le\Pi$.
For a large interior step, $|f'-f|\le(1-f)+(1-f')$; each reflection
deficit is bounded by the sum of $e^{-2uv/T'}$ over monitored walls.
If $w_\eta>M_\eta$, all their endpoint distances from that wall
are at least $w_\eta-M_\eta$, and the future variance is at most $T$;
otherwise that wall's summand of $\Pi$ is one. Thus the deficits
cost $C\Pi$. By \eqref{cn:derivative}, the compensation is at most
$C(q+q^2|d|/\sqrt T)DP\le CqD^2\Pi$.
Here $q\le1$, and $q>1/\sqrt2$ lets $q^3$ pay both one and $q$.
At any crossing its crossed wall has $0<w_\eta\le|b|\le M_\eta$,
so $\Pi\ge1$: use \eqref{cn:projectbound} for a small crossing. At a large crossing its future completion is
zero, so $|f'-f|\le1$; the same compensation bound proves the claim.
Equality hits are crossings, and a reachable zero-time interior future
has deficit zero. No separated positive overshoot is included.
\end{proof}

module

prelude
public import Lean.MonadEnv

namespace Lean

namespace CollectAxioms

structure State where
  /-- Cache mapping constants to their (sorted) axiom dependencies. -/
  seen   : NameMap (Array Name) := {}
  /-- Axioms accumulated for the current constant being processed. -/
  axioms : NameSet := {}

abbrev M := ReaderT Environment $ StateM State

def runM (env : Environment) (x : M α) : α :=
  x.run env |>.run' {}

def insertArray (s : NameSet) (axs : Array Name) : NameSet :=
  axs.foldl (init := s) fun acc ax => acc.insert ax

/--
Collect axioms reachable from constant `c`, using `extFind?` to look up pre-computed axioms
for imported declarations. Results are cached in `State.seen`.

When processing a constant not found in `extFind?` or the cache, the function temporarily
clears the axiom accumulator, recurses into the constant's dependencies, caches the result
in `seen`, and merges the collected axioms back.
-/
partial def collect
    (extFind? : Environment → Name → Option (Array Name))
    (c : Name) : M Unit := do
  let env ← read
  -- Check extension for pre-computed axioms (imported declarations)
  if let some axs := extFind? env c then
    modify fun s => { s with axioms := insertArray s.axioms axs, seen := s.seen.insert c axs }
    return
  -- Check local cache
  let s ← get
  if let some axs := s.seen.find? c then
    modify fun s => { s with axioms := insertArray s.axioms axs }
    return
  -- Recurse: temporarily clear axioms to isolate this constant's contribution.
  -- Insert sentinel to prevent infinite recursion (e.g., inductives ↔ constructors).
  let savedAxioms := s.axioms
  modify fun s => { s with axioms := {}, seen := s.seen.insert c #[] }
  let collectExpr (e : Expr) : M Unit := e.getUsedConstants.forM (collect extFind?)
  -- Take constants from the kernel env, which may differ from the elab env for (async) errors.
  match env.checked.get.find? c with
  | some (.axiomInfo v)  =>
      modify fun s => { s with axioms := s.axioms.insert c }
      collectExpr v.type
  | some (.defnInfo v)   => collectExpr v.type *> collectExpr v.value
  | some (.thmInfo v)    => collectExpr v.type *> collectExpr v.value
  | some (.opaqueInfo v) => collectExpr v.type *> collectExpr v.value
  | some (.quotInfo _)   => pure ()
  | some (.ctorInfo v)   => collectExpr v.type
  | some (.recInfo v)    => collectExpr v.type
  | some (.inductInfo v) => collectExpr v.type *> v.ctors.forM (collect extFind?)
  | none                 => pure ()
  -- Cache result (sorted for canonical order) and merge back into saved axioms
  let collected := (← get).axioms
  let result := collected.toArray.qsort Name.lt
  modify fun s => { s with
    seen   := s.seen.insert c result
    axioms := insertArray savedAxioms result
  }

/-- Collect axioms for `c` and return its sorted axiom list from the cache. -/
def collectAndGet
    (extFind? : Environment → Name → Option (Array Name))
    (c : Name) : M (Array Name) := do
  collect extFind? c
  let some axs := (← get).seen.find? c | panic! s!"collectAndGet: '{c}' not in seen after collect"
  return axs

end CollectAxioms

/--
Extension state holding imported module entries for efficient lookup of
pre-computed axiom data.

We use `registerPersistentEnvExtension` with manual lookup instead of `MapDeclarationExtension`
because `exportEntriesFnEx` needs to call `collect`, which needs the extension's `find?`, but
`exportEntriesFnEx` is defined inside the `builtin_initialize` that creates the extension and
thus cannot reference it. This state replicates `MapDeclarationExtension.find?`'s per-module
binary search without requiring the extension object.
-/
structure ExportedAxiomsState where
  importedModuleEntries : Array (Array (Name × Array Name)) := #[]

instance : Inhabited ExportedAxiomsState := ⟨{}⟩

/-- Look up pre-computed axioms for an imported declaration. -/
def ExportedAxiomsState.find? (s : ExportedAxiomsState) (env : Environment)
    (c : Name) : Option (Array Name) :=
  match env.getModuleIdxFor? c with
  | some modIdx =>
    if h : modIdx.toNat < s.importedModuleEntries.size then
      match s.importedModuleEntries[modIdx].binSearch (c, #[]) (fun a b => Name.quickLt a.1 b.1) with
      | some entry => some entry.2
      | none       => none
    else none
  | none => none

/--
Environment extension that records axiom dependencies for all declarations in a module.
Entries are computed once by `beforeExportFn` when the olean is serialized, not during
elaboration. During elaboration, `collectAxioms` walks bodies directly. Downstream modules
look up pre-computed entries for imported declarations, so axiom collection never crosses
module boundaries.
-/
builtin_initialize exportedAxiomsExt :
    PersistentEnvExtension (Name × Array Name) (Name × Array Name) ExportedAxiomsState ←
  registerPersistentEnvExtension {
    mkInitial     := pure {}
    addImportedFn := fun importedEntries => pure { importedModuleEntries := importedEntries }
    addEntryFn    := fun s _ => s
    exportEntriesFnEx := fun env s =>
      let exportedEnv := env.setExporting true
      let privateEnv := env.setExporting false
      -- Collect current-module declarations visible in the exported view.
      -- By pre-computing axiom data for every exported declaration, downstream modules can
      -- look up any imported declaration without walking its body, keeping collection
      -- module-local.
      let allNames := env.checked.get.constants.foldStage2
        (fun names name _ =>
          if (exportedEnv.find? name).isSome then names.push name
          else names) #[]
      -- Compute axioms within a shared state (for caching across declarations).
      -- Use `privateEnv` so that `collect` can see all constant bodies.
      let entries := CollectAxioms.runM privateEnv do
        allNames.mapM fun name =>
          return (name, ← CollectAxioms.collectAndGet s.find? name)
      -- Sort by name for binary search at import time.
      let entries := entries.qsort fun a b => Name.quickLt a.1 b.1
      .uniform entries
    asyncMode     := .mainOnly
  }

/-- Collect all axioms transitively used by a constant. -/
public def collectAxioms [Monad m] [MonadEnv m] (constName : Name) : m (Array Name) := do
  let env ← getEnv
  let privateEnv := env.setExporting false
  let s := exportedAxiomsExt.getState (asyncMode := .mainOnly) env
  return CollectAxioms.runM privateEnv do
    CollectAxioms.collectAndGet s.find? constName

end Lean
